title: Multi-panel figure
label: Panel label
source: Figure to copy into this panel
help: Each panel keeps its own saved data, uncertainty, annotations and design. Copying a figure takes a snapshot; later edits to the original do not change this panel. Shared ranges require matching axis types, scales and labels. On narrow screens, panels stack vertically.
replace: Replace this panel with a copy of the selected figure?
removeConfirm: Remove this panel and its measurements from this figure?
invalidPanel: Each panel needs a unique identity, a label and a supported plot.
incompatible: Shared axes require matching coordinate types, scales, axis labels and plot orientation. Category coordinates cannot share a range.
limits: Use between two and eight panels and one to three columns.
annotationHelp: Annotations use the plot's axis coordinates. They describe boundaries or intervals without changing measurements or the fitted data range. Coordinates outside the visible range are clipped; the data table retains every annotation.
annotationLayoutHelp: Automatic places labels on the plot when they fit and uses a key below it when they would overlap. The key includes full labels and exact coordinates. Hiding labels keeps the boundaries, intervals and data table.
annotationInvalid: Annotations need unique identities, valid coordinates, labels, colors and opacity from 0 to 1.
annotationRange: An interval's end must be greater than its start; logarithmic coordinates must be positive. Coordinate annotations require numeric or date coordinates.
annotationLimit: A plot can contain up to 64 annotations.
resultLimit: This copy would exceed the record's 64 supporting results. Use a separate record for additional figures.
missingPanelResult: No supporting result is declared for panel {panel}.
resultAttached: This figure has supporting results. Retarget or remove those results before removing or replacing the figure.
